# Cannot set specific price with currency filter

When setting specific price for a product, if (non default) currency is used in filter, it's not possible to enter new price in "target" currency.

The table shows like it's been set properly, see: 
![image](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/assets/9821742/a546a41f-4f85-4b79-8f8b-2e014300ecd9)

But in reality, price is set in default currency and calculated through exchange rate on Frontend: 
![image](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/assets/9821742/93b8586c-b968-4c4b-99b3-482b0f692527)

(!) important note - this had worked in PS 1.7.8.x, although the input prompt for specific prices said the currency being entered is base currency, it actually used it properly as target currency. In PS 8.0.3, it ain't working anymore this way.

## Attendu
Rationale behind this is to allow shop owner set up nicely rounded fixed price for different currencies.

Partial workaround to date is setting up exchange rate to 1:1 with base currency, however that messes up shipping cost.

## Étapes
1. Import localization pack of another country (e.g. base currency is EUR, import Czech Republic for CZK)
2. Edit product page in the BO
3. Set specific price to be a fixed amount for CZK
4. Result: On the Frontend, fixed price is NOT used.

ÉTAPE 1 LOCALISER. Réponds en JSON : {"keywords": ["...", "..."]} (3 à 8 mots-clés).
